units.source_text: 紫姬并不十分怨恨源氏，然而，恐怕是她夜夜如此烦恼之故，有一晚出现在源氏的梦中。

en.t: Lady Murasaki did not deeply resent Genji, yet perhaps because she was troubled like this night after night, one evening she appeared in Genji's dream.

units.source_text: 源氏惊醒，不知出了何事，心中甚是慌张。

en.t: Genji woke with a start, not knowing what had happened, and was greatly alarmed at heart.

units.source_text: 等到听见鸡声，便不管天色还黑，匆匆起身言归。

en.t: When he heard the rooster crow, he paid no mind to the sky still being dark, but hurriedly rose and said he would return home.

units.source_text: 三公主年纪还小，有乳母等睡在近旁服侍。

en.t: The Third Princess was still young, and her nurses and others slept nearby to attend on her.

units.source_text: 源氏自己开了边门出去，乳母扶三公主起来目送。

en.t: Genji opened the side door himself and went out, while the nurse helped the Third Princess rise to see him off.

units.source_text: 天色未明，但见一片雪光，此外模糊难辨。

en.t: The sky was not yet light; only the glow of the snow could be seen, and everything else was blurred and hard to distinguish.

units.source_text: 源氏出门之后，衣香犹自弥漫室中，便有人独吟“春夜何妨暗”的古歌。

en.t: After Genji had gone out, the fragrance of his robes still filled the room, and someone softly recited alone the old poem saying that a spring night may well be dark.

units.source_text: 庭中处处残雪未消，但望去与洁白的铺石无甚差别。

en.t: Here and there in the garden the remaining snow had not yet melted, but from a distance it was hardly different from the white paving stones.

units.source_text: 源氏走到西厅，一面低声吟咏白居易“子城阴处犹残雪”之诗，一面伸手敲格子门。

en.t: Genji walked to the western wing, quietly chanting Bai Juyi's line about snow still remaining in the shaded part of the inner city, while reaching out to knock on the lattice door.

units.source_text: 因为长久没有夜出朝归之事了，所以侍女们都还在假寐，等了许久，方才开门。

en.t: Because it had been a long time since he had gone out at night and returned in the morning, the waiting women were still dozing, and only after he waited a long while did they open the door.

units.source_text: 源氏对紫姬说道：“我在门外等了好久，身体也发冷了。

en.t: Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "I waited outside the door for a long time, and my body has grown cold as well.

units.source_text: 我这么老早归来，是为了对你担心太深之故，这不算过失吧。”

en.t: I came back this early because I was so deeply worried about you; surely that cannot count as a fault."

units.source_text: 他就伸手替紫姬取去填在身子下面的衣服。

en.t: He then reached out and removed the robes that had been tucked beneath Lady Murasaki's body.

units.source_text: 紫姬连忙把稍稍泪湿的单衫衣袖藏过，装作和蔼可亲、毫无怨恨的样子，但又并无放怀不拘之状，其姿态之优雅令人叹佩。

en.t: Lady Murasaki quickly hid the sleeve of her unlined robe, which was slightly damp with tears, and pretended to be gentle, approachable, and entirely free of resentment; yet she showed no careless openness, and the grace of her bearing was admirable.

units.source_text: 源氏在心中把她和三公主比较，觉得无论何等高贵的人，总赶不上这位紫夫人。

en.t: In his heart Genji compared her with the Third Princess and felt that no matter how noble a woman might be, she could never match this Lady Murasaki.
